DOI_INFO.title: FLUXNET2015 DE-Tha Tharandt
DOI_INFO.doi_description:
This is the FLUXNET2015 version of the carbon flux data for the site DE-Tha Tharandt. Site Description - The Anchor Station Tharandt (50.96235°N, 13.56516°E, 385 m a.s.l.) is located in the Eastern part of a large forested area (60 km²) near the city of Tharandt, about 25 km SW of Dresden. This forest has a long history of forestry documentation as well as meteorological and hydrological measurements.
